data.why: the repo ships synthetic TOF-SIMS spectra plus a one-click in-memory demo mode, so no new data needs to be authored

goals: upload multiple TOF-SIMS mass spectra and align them to a common m/z axis for direct comparison
apply and compare normalization schemes (TIC, mean-centering, autoscaling, Poisson scaling) and see how they change the overlay
compute a difference spectrum between two samples and identify the top differing m/z peaks (e.g. a contamination marker)
run PCA on the aligned spectra, inspect score and loading plots, and export the PCA scores
perform hierarchical clustering on samples or top-variance m/z to find compositional groupings
export the aligned spectrum table and PCA scores as CSV for downstream use

review.summary: The tree states the tool's purpose well (align TOF-SIMS spectra, preprocess, compare two samples by difference, then group all samples with PCA/HCA and export), every sampled screen backs its node, and the second agent replayed all 14 tasks and 5 features. Before filing it needs light restructuring: scaling belongs with the multivariate steps, the deep-link phase and two click-level tasks should be demoted, and the t13 '1 Da' claim should be corrected.
